usedFor: Daftra holds your product records, and Loyverse is the register, so “New Product Added” can run “Create Or Update Variant”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Added” in Daftra, then “Create Or Update Variant” in Loyverse
bestTemplate.why: A product added in Daftra shows up in Loyverse as a variant, so the register matches your catalog.

watchOut: “New Product Added” in Daftra is polling, so the Loyverse variant appears after a scheduled check.
